postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if stdin == username + '@' + hostname + (('/' + resource) if '/' in stdin else '') and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_' for c in username) and 1 <= len(username) <= 16 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_' for c in resource) and 1 <= len(resource) <= 16 and '@' in stdin and (resource_part := stdin.split('@')[1].split('/')[0]) and all(part in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_' for part in resource_part.split('.')) and all(1 <= len(part) <= 16 for part in resource_part.split('.')) and 1 <= len(resource_part) <= 32 and (resource_part := stdin.split('@')[1].split('/')[1]) is None or (1 <= len(resource_part) <= 16 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_' for c in resource_part)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Outputs 'YES' if the input string is a valid Jabber ID according to the specified rules, otherwise outputs 'NO'.
